keyFindings.description: The PR conflicts with main, so no CI exists at the code head; it needs a forward merge of main (never a rebase). Main's #2501 took 0141 (0141_drop_broadcast_idempotency_keys); the files merge without a textual conflict, but pgmigrate refuses two migrations with one version (internal/pgmigrate/set.go), so every boot and store test fails after a merge that keeps both. Renumber to 0142 and update the README (1267, 1276), AGENTS.md (1405, 3288), the changelog fragment and the body.

A queued mention attempt is committed unclaimed and claimed only when its lane starts the send. Once it is a minute old, model.OwedMentionAttemptSQL makes it owed, and the delivery sweep (any process, every minute, 4 at a time) sends it while the lane is still sending earlier comments to that recipient. A recipient behind a slow listener therefore gets comments out of order from a process that never stopped. Every such attempt also flips to resumed in the outbox and gets a fallback row. AGENTS.md:1423-1425 says the sweep never takes a live process's queue out of order; the changelog fragment and body promise order per recipient. Fix: keep a live process's queued attempts out of the sweep (claim at enqueue and keep the claim fresh while queued, or an equivalent), with a test of a lane held more than a lease.

A fallback row waiting on a send or resend is released with next_attempt_at null, so every 5 s retry tick claims it again and re-reads its comment's attempts (2 queries plus claim and record), up to 100 rows: load in the post-restart minutes this PR exists to calm. Release a waiting row with a delay (mentionPendingDelay or the sweep interval).

comment_fallback_copies has no foreign key and is not in the browser suite's reset list, while the reset truncates events with restart identity, so an unsettled row from one scenario can publish whichever later event holds its event_id to an agent topic. Add the table to the reset.
